title: Separating price from the ranking network reduced bookings

change.control: Two-hidden-layer fully connected DNN with price among input features.
change.variant: Remove price from DNN inputs and subtract a monotonic tanh price term from its score.

quote: But the interpretability of price came at a heavy cost as bookings dropped by − 1.5 %
notes: Average search-result price fell 5.7%; offline train and test NDCG also fell. The experiment changed ranking, not listed prices.

verification_details.reason: company, lift and supporting quote confirmed; not a statistical replication
